description: Mechanical nudges for the fusion-parametric-design doctrine, loaded by both harnesses (Claude Code and Codex share this hook contract): a blocking gate on the Fusion MCP execute tool (process-spawning constructs are always refused; oversized ad hoc scripts are refused unless they carry the shipped lane tooling's line-anchored report-protocol signature), and a warn-only reminder when a file-write tool targets ordinary-modeling artifact smells outside the skill's own tree. The doctrine text is the cross-harness authority; these hooks fail open on their own confusion.
